review:
Forty Fruity Million is a 40-line fruit slot with two scatters, stacked symbols and multiplying expanding wilds. Wilds appear only on reels 2, 3 and 4.

When a wild expands to fill its reel and a win forms, the expanded wild randomly gets a 1x, 2x or 3x multiplier. One scatter pays for three to five symbols anywhere; the other appears only on reels 1, 3 and 5 and pays for three. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 6,000x maximum and a 96.1% RTP. It's a punchier version of the classic fruit formula, with no free spins round.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
